unit_regression.notes: Full engineering suite (store, migrations, tools, SSRF-safe download, MCP stdio via official SDK client, Apple XML import, TLS ingest protocol, worker, backup). [run-manifests/engineering.json]

auth_and_policy.notes: Read-only tool profile enforced server-side; SQL authorizer; device tokens hashed; Oura durable registration/ingest refused; synthetic sources refused in production; eval security category in eval-report/summary.json. [run-manifests/engineering.json]

durable_capture.notes: Receipts only after COMMIT; SIGKILL mid-burst leaves records==receipts, integrity ok; same-key retry idempotent; new-process read. [run-manifests/recovery.json]

original_file_integrity.notes: Real HTTPS download → SHA-256 verified original; failed/partial/oversize/SSRF refused with nothing persisted; disk-full leaves no object row. [run-manifests/engineering.json]

local_restore.notes: Online snapshot during writes → verify → restore into new root → counts match; production paths also restored (recovery-report/production_local_restore.log). [run-manifests/recovery.json]

chatgpt_read_write.notes: ChatGPT web wrote a capture (committed receipt) and read it back. [live observation, bound to delivery/live-evidence/chatgpt_live_probe.json]

chatgpt_files.notes: Photo and 2-page PDF saved from ChatGPT with local SHA-256 == stored SHA-256; pages readable. [live observation, bound to delivery/live-evidence/chatgpt_live_probe.json]

fresh_conversation.notes: A new ChatGPT chat found the earlier capture by content. [live observation, bound to delivery/live-evidence/chatgpt_live_probe.json]

apple_device_sync.notes: Helper not built: needs Xcode licence (sudo), Apple ID signing and the iPhone — deferred by the user. Two routes now exist — this repo's own ios/HealthSyncHelper, or the open-source Life Dashboard Companion webhook receiver (src/phctx/companion.py, ios/COMPANION_SETUP.md) — neither is installed on-device. Swift core tests, TLS interop, and companion signature/replay tests pass; full export backfill is in production.

oura_official_access.notes: No official Oura MCP connector route available to this account for ChatGPT (live-evidence/p0_account_probe_2026-09-23.md); unchanged since that probe. Oura data is instead synced directly as a durable source via Oura API v2 (src/phctx/oura.py, hourly launchd job com.personalhealthcontext.oura; ~250k observations in production per ops/status.sh) — this closes the data-access gap but is not the official MCP route this check names, so it stays BLOCKED.

model_eval.notes: Evidence is not bound to the current tree by a run manifest. Real model runs on synthetic fixtures; case PASS requires every run to pass (critical safety cases 3 runs). dev 42/42, holdout 14/14. Hard failures: none. Host is Codex CLI, not the ChatGPT client.

sparse_proactivity.notes: Evidence is not bound to the current tree by a run manifest. Real worker + strong model on synthetic fixtures: silence and revisit categories.

background_shadow.notes: Background model disabled in production (user decision pending, USER_ACTIONS §4); no multi-day shadow observation.

restart_recovery.notes: Evidence is not bound to the current tree by a run manifest. launchd uninstall/reinstall keeps data and runs; killed worker lease recovers; Mac sleep/wake not tested.

encrypted_backup_restore.notes: AES-256-GCM archive written to iCloud Drive, read back, decrypted, restored into a new root (synthetic data); tamper rejected. Production cloud backup is opt-in (USER_ACTIONS §5). [run-manifests/recovery.json]

single_interface.notes: ChatGPT is the only daily interface: write, read, files, fresh chat, real-data investigation observed live. The iPhone helper is a one-time setup screen. [live observation, bound to delivery/live-evidence/chatgpt_live_probe.json]
